277595189.description:
Set of three vintage Avon figural glass bottles with a dog theme. The largest is a brown amber Saint Bernard style dog with a gold tone cord and barrel around the neck, labeled Avon Spicy After Shave 5 FL. OZ., Avon Products, Inc., N.Y., N.Y. 10019. The small white milk glass Scottish terrier has a gold tone collar and a base label reading Cotillion Cologne 1 FL. OZ., Avon Products, Inc., New York, N.Y. 10019. The third is a cream colored bulldog head forming a smoking pipe, with a black stem, a silver tone band and AVON molded into the base. Sold as a group of three bottles only, with no boxes. Contents unknown.

Condition: Used display condition. Light surface soil and small speckles on the white pieces, tarnish and spotting on the silver tone band and gold tone barrel. Labels worn.

277566390.description:
Two piece writing set from Pierre Cardin in a matte silver tone finish with chrome tone clips and accent bands. One is a ballpoint pen and the other a mechanical pencil, both held in a white plastic clip marked Pierre Cardin. The set comes in the black hinged gift box it was stored in, with the box interior printed pierre cardin PARIS NEW YORK Lifetime Warranty. The underside of the box carries a barcode label and is marked CHINA. No refills or spare leads are included. Untested, sold as is.

Condition: Light handling marks on the barrels. Small tan stain on the white insert and light scuffing and dust on the box exterior.

277456575.description: This vintage calligraphy and technical drawing set includes bottles and boxes of drawing ink from Pelikan and Higgins brands, featuring Tusch Drawing Ink, T-100, and Black Magic Professional India Ink. The set contains a decorative black feather quill pen, a Speedball 'C' Style Lettering Set with pen holder and assorted nibs, a Doubleheader Calligraphy pen, a Sheaffer NoNonsense pen, and a dusting brush. Many items remain in their original packaging, showing signs of age and handling such as minor wear. Overall, the set offers a variety of vintage calligraphy and drawing supplies with some visible imperfections consistent with their age.
